svg.title: detect_pattern turns one sentence into a plan of detection steps
svg.desc: An agent sends one plain-language query to detect_pattern. The server builds a plan from the sphere's capabilities and runs its four steps itself: find_anomalies, find_regime_changes, compare_time_windows and attract_boundary. On the right, the query fans out to the steps; the seven anomalous accounts light up beyond theta and the boundary step points at its top entities. Distance from the centroid is real (sqrt of delta_norm / theta_norm); angles are illustrative.
svg.text: One sentence in; the server plans and runs the steps.
